gaps.lead: It took the artist three weeks to paint the mural.
gaps.explanation: it took X time to do = X spent time doing: spent over three weeks on.

gaps.lead: The tickets are certain to be expensive this year.
gaps.explanation: be bound to do = be certain to do.

gaps.lead: 'I'm sorry I was so rude to your sister,' Maria said.
gaps.sentence: Maria apologised ___ so rude to my sister.
gaps.explanation: apologise for + -ing: apologised for being so rude.

gaps.lead: The party was incredibly boring, so we left early.
gaps.sentence: The party was ___ we left early.

gaps.lead: You didn't tell me about the meeting, and you should have.
gaps.sentence: You really ___ me about the meeting.
gaps.explanation: ought to have + participle = should have done (but didn't).
last did X in (year) = haven't done X since (year).
